serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Glytec’s Glucommander® is an FDA-cleared software-as-a-medical-device (SaMD), utilized for diabetes management and automated insulin titration. Glucommander is purpose-built to improve patient safety and clinical outcomes. Glucommander provides clinicians, hospitalists, and medical facilities with constant, data-driven dosing recommendations that stabilize blood glucose levels and decrease the incidences of hypoglycemia, length of stays and readmissions.
